title: pvImageDataToAMR
body:
## pvImageDataToAMR

Converts a uniform image (vtkImageData, at least 2-D) into an overlapping AMR dataset (vtkOverlappingAMR). The input image is the finest level; coarser levels are generated from it with RefinementRatio between consecutive levels, and the hierarchy is split into at most MaximumNumberofBlocks blocks. No resolution is added. Use it to feed AMR operations such as pvExtractAMRBlocks, pvAMRContour or pvResampleAMR from image data.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Each image dimension minus one must be divisible by RefinementRatio^(Numberoflevels − 1); e.g. 65 points per axis with ratio 2 allows up to 7 levels. Otherwise the filter fails with "Image cannot be refined".
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ImageDataToAMR`. Identity: `filters/ImageDataToAMR`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Cell Data to Point Data filter. Accepted data: image data (uniform rectilinear grids) (vtkImageData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkImageData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `MaximumNumberofBlocks` | This property specifies the maximum number of blocks in the output AMR data structure. | `{"maximum":100000,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Numberoflevels` | This property specifies the number of levels in the AMR data structure. | `{"maximum":20,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `RefinementRatio` | Refinement ratio between consecutive AMR levels, an integer from 2 to 16. Schemaxis rejects 1 because VTK clamps the ratio to at least 2 (ParaView's own range starts at 1, so a value of 1 would silently run as 2 while still reading back as 1). | `{"maximum":16,"minimum":2,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `2` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvImageDataToAMR",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
